Re: Parker Nicholson (DOB 07/09/1947)

Dear Life Insurer,

I am writing to provide a detailed medical history for Mr. Parker Nicholson, who has been under my care since 2008 when he was diagnosed with stage II thyroid cancer. Below is a summary of his recent visits and current status.

On May 20, 2025, Mr. Nicholson visited for a follow-up regarding his cancer. His blood pressure at that visit was 141/76, and he weighed 206 pounds. Mr. Nicholson's thyroid cancer, stage II, has been controlled since his treatment approximately 16.1 years ago. He is currently taking levothyroxine 100 mcg daily as part of his ongoing management.

On January 3, 2025, Mr. Nicholson came in for a rash evaluation. His blood pressure was recorded at 143/75, and he weighed pounds. Despite the rash, his thyroid cancer remains in a controlled status post treatment.

In August 19, 2024, Mr. Nicholson returned for a routine cancer check-up. His blood pressure was 152/74, and he weighed 211 pounds. He reported feeling well overall, with no new symptoms related to his cancer.

On April 3, 2024, he visited for a medication refill. His blood pressure was 143/73, and he weighed 218 pounds. At that time, he was doing well, and there were no concerns about his thyroid cancer.

A follow-up visit on November 18, 2023, showed a blood pressure of 150/78 and a weight of 210 pounds. Mr. Nicholson continues to do well, and his thyroid cancer remains in a controlled status since his treatment approximately 16.1 years ago.

On July 4, 2023, Mr. Nicholson's visit was also for cancer follow-up. His blood pressure was 140/77, and he weighed 208 pounds. There were no new developments concerning his thyroid cancer.

On February 16, 2023, Mr. Nicholson's blood pressure was 149/83, and he weighed 207 pounds. He reported feeling well, and his thyroid cancer continued to be controlled.

The visit on October 2, 2022, recorded a blood pressure of 146/84 and a weight of 212 pounds. Mr. Nicholson remained in good health, and there no new concerns his thyroid cancer.

Regarding his lifestyle, Mr. Nicholson is non-compliant with his medications and has missed appointments on two occasions. He is a current chew tobacco user, consuming several times a day, and his start date for this habit was September 28, 2021. He reports an honest disclosure of his tobacco use. Additionally, he consumes approximately alcoholic drinks per week.

Socially, Mr. Nicholson has a family history of Alzheimer's disease, which affected his father at the age of 78. His father is s

till living.

In summary, Mr. Nicholson's thyroid cancer, stage has been effectively managed for over 16 years. Despite some non-compliance with medications and missed appointments, his cancer remains controlled. His overall health appears stable, with no new concerning symptoms.

Please let me know if you require any further information.

Sincerely,

Dr. Barbara Johnson, MD
Oncology
